title: Dr. Anthony Fauci Uses Constitutional Right to Remain Silent at Senate Hearing
subtitle: The former top health official declines to answer questions amid new controversy over private diary entries

summary.en: Former health official Anthony Fauci recently appeared before a Senate committee to discuss the COVID-19 pandemic. During the meeting, he chose to use his Fifth Amendment right to avoid answering questions. This constitutional right allows a person to refuse to provide information that might be used against them in a legal case. The hearing follows the release of private diary entries by Senator Rand Paul. The two men have disagreed for years regarding the origins of the coronavirus.
summary.zh: 前衛生官員安東尼·佛奇博士近日出席參議院委員會，討論新冠肺炎疫情。會議期間，他選擇行使憲法第五修正案賦予的權利，拒絕回答提問。這項憲法權利允許個人拒絕提供可能在法律訴訟中對自己不利的資訊。此次聽證會是在參議員蘭德·保羅公開佛奇博士的私人日記後舉行。兩人多年來一直對新冠病毒的起源意見不合。

paragraphs.en: In a tense meeting on Capitol Hill this week, former top health official Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer questions from a Senate committee. Dr. Fauci, who led the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) during the COVID-19 pandemic, stated that he was acting on the advice of his lawyers. He invoked the Fifth Amendment, a part of the United States Constitution that allows a person to refuse to provide information that could potentially be used against them in a legal case.
paragraphs.zh: 在本週一場氣氛緊張的國會山莊會議中，前頂尖衛生官員安東尼·佛奇（Anthony Fauci）博士拒絕回答參議院委員會的提問。佛奇博士曾在新冠肺炎疫情期間領導國家過敏與傳染病研究院（NIAID），他表示自己是遵照律師的建議行事。他援引了美國憲法第五修正案，該條款允許個人拒絕提供可能在法律訴訟中對自己不利的資訊。

paragraphs.en: "Although it pains me to do so, because of the respect I have for the legislative branch of government, and my decades-long record of cooperating with Congress, under the advice of my attorneys, I will invoke my right under the Fifth Amendment of the Constitution to refrain from answering your questions," Dr. Fauci said during the hearing. The committee, led by Senator Rand Paul of Kentucky, had subpoenaed Dr. Fauci to appear. A subpoena is a formal legal order requiring a person to attend a hearing or provide evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 佛奇博士在聽證會上表示：「儘管我對此感到痛苦，但基於我對立法部門的尊重，以及我數十年來與國會合作的紀錄，在律師的建議下，我將援引憲法第五修正案賦予我的權利，拒絕回答各位的問題。」由肯塔基州參議員蘭德·保羅（Rand Paul）領導的委員會先前已對佛奇博士發出傳票。傳票是一種正式的法律命令，要求當事人出席聽證會或提供證據。

paragraphs.en: This event is the latest development in a long-standing disagreement between Dr. Fauci and Senator Paul. For years, the two have debated the origins of the coronavirus that caused the global pandemic. The discussion often focuses on whether the virus emerged naturally or if it accidentally escaped from the Wuhan Institute of Virology, a laboratory in China that studies bat coronaviruses. This theory is often called the "lab leak" theory.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件是佛奇博士與保羅參議員之間長期爭執的最新發展。多年來，兩人一直針對導致全球疫情的新冠病毒起源進行辯論。討論焦點通常集中在病毒是自然演化，還是意外從中國研究蝙蝠冠狀病毒的武漢病毒研究所外洩。這種理論通常被稱為「實驗室外洩」假說。

paragraphs.en: Just days before the hearing, Senator Paul released over 1,000 pages of Dr. Fauci’s private diary entries. These documents cover Dr. Fauci’s daily life and work between December 2019 and his retirement in December 2022. Senator Paul claims that these private notes show a difference between what Dr. Fauci believed in private and what he told the public. In a post on social media, Senator Paul argued that the diary entries prove Dr. Fauci was hiding information about the virus's origins.
paragraphs.zh: 就在聽證會前幾天，保羅參議員公開了超過一千頁佛奇博士的私人日記。這些文件涵蓋了佛奇博士從二零一九年十二月到二零二二年十二月退休期間的日常生活與工作。保羅參議員聲稱，這些私人筆記顯示佛奇博士私下的想法與他對公眾的說法存在差異。保羅參議員在社群媒體上發文主張，這些日記內容證明佛奇博士隱瞞了關於病毒起源的資訊。

paragraphs.en: However, Dr. Fauci’s team has strongly rejected these accusations. A spokesperson for Dr. Fauci provided a document to address the senator’s claims. Furthermore, a letter from Dr. Fauci’s legal team to Senator Paul described the senator’s actions as a "years-long public crusade." The lawyers argued that Senator Paul is focused on trying to see Dr. Fauci prosecuted for "imaginary crimes" and has built a personal brand around attacking him. During the hearing, Dr. Fauci himself noted that he had already answered similar questions in previous testimony and suggested that the senator is obsessed with trying to get him into legal trouble.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，佛奇博士的團隊強烈駁斥了這些指控。佛奇博士的發言人提供了一份文件來回應參議員的說法。此外，佛奇博士的法律團隊致函保羅參議員，將參議員的行為描述為一場「長達數年的公眾討伐」。律師們主張，保羅參議員一心只想看到佛奇博士因「虛構的罪名」被起訴，並圍繞著攻擊他來建立個人品牌。在聽證會期間，佛奇博士本人指出，他先前已在證詞中回答過類似問題，並暗示這位參議員執著於讓他陷入法律麻煩。

paragraphs.en: NPR Health reports that the diary entries include notes from a conference call on February 1, 2020, where Dr. Fauci and other scientists discussed the virus. In those notes, Dr. Fauci wrote that there was not total agreement among the experts at that time. Later entries show that Dr. Fauci felt it was very likely the virus came from a natural "species jump," meaning it moved from animals to humans. However, he also noted that he kept an open mind about other possibilities, including a lab leak. Many scientists have explained that this changing view is normal, as it reflects how the scientific community’s understanding of COVID-19 grew over time.
paragraphs.zh: 美國公共廣播電台（NPR）健康版報導，這些日記內容包含二零二零年二月一日一場電話會議的筆記，當時佛奇博士與其他科學家討論了病毒。在筆記中，佛奇博士寫道，當時專家們尚未達成完全共識。後續的日記顯示，佛奇博士認為病毒極有可能是透過自然的「物種跳躍」傳播，意即從動物傳染給人類。不過，他也提到自己對其他可能性保持開放態度，包括實驗室外洩。許多科學家解釋，這種觀點的轉變是很正常的，因為這反映了科學界對新冠肺炎的理解隨著時間推移而增加。

paragraphs.en: Senator Paul’s release of these documents has been controversial. He posted the diary entries online, removed them, and then reposted them with certain parts hidden, or redacted. He also released a large collection of older documents and emails from 2001 to 2015, which he called a "prequel" to the diary. These actions have intensified the public debate over how the pandemic began and whether government officials were fully transparent with the American people.
paragraphs.zh: 保羅參議員公開這些文件的做法引發了爭議。他在網路上發布了這些日記，隨後將其撤下，接著又將部分內容隱藏或塗黑後重新發布。他還公開了一大批從二零零一年到二零一五年的舊文件與電子郵件，並稱之為日記的「前傳」。這些舉動加劇了公眾對於疫情如何開始，以及政府官員是否對美國人民完全透明的辯論。

paragraphs.en: As the situation continues, it remains unclear what the next steps will be. The use of the Fifth Amendment effectively stopped the questioning during the hearing, leaving many of the senator's inquiries unanswered. For now, the divide between the two sides remains wide, with Senator Paul continuing to push for more investigation and Dr. Fauci’s representatives maintaining that the accusations are part of a politically motivated campaign. The debate over the origins of the pandemic is likely to continue as more documents and information are reviewed by both sides.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著局勢持續發展，下一步會如何仍不明朗。援引第五修正案有效地中斷了聽證會上的質詢，導致參議員提出的許多問題未獲解答。目前，雙方的分歧依然巨大，保羅參議員持續推動更多調查，而佛奇博士的代表則堅持這些指控是政治動機行動的一部分。隨著雙方審閱更多文件與資訊，關於疫情起源的辯論很可能會持續下去。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cite or appeal to a law, rule, or right to support one's actions.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 援引（法律、權利等）作為行動的依據。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在法律語境中常見，意指正式引用權利。文中：He invoked the Fifth Amendment, a part of the United States Constitution that allows a person to refuse to provide information that could potentially be used against them in a legal case.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （為某種信念或目標進行的）長期運動或鬥爭。
keyTerms.noteZh: 原指十字軍東征，這裡引申為針對某人的長期政治攻擊。文中：Furthermore, a letter from Dr. Fauci’s legal team to Senator Paul described the senator’s actions as a "years-long public crusade."

keyTerms.definitionEn: To remove or hide sensitive information from a document before it is released.
keyTerms.definitionZh: （對文件）進行塗改、刪除敏感資訊。
keyTerms.noteZh: 在法律與新聞語境中常用，指為了保護隱私或機密而遮蓋內容。文中：He posted the diary entries online, removed them, and then reposted them with certain parts hidden, or redacted.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Former top US health official Anthony Fauci recently appeared before a US Senate committee. During the hearing, he chose to use his Fifth Amendment right to avoid answering questions. This constitutional right allows a person to refuse to provide information that could be used against them in a criminal case. Senator Rand Paul led the questioning, focusing on the origins of the pandemic and past health policies. The event highlights the deep political divisions in the United States regarding the management of the health crisis.

quiz.question: What reason did Dr. Fauci give for refusing to answer the committee's questions?

options.A: He claimed the committee did not have the legal authority to subpoena him.
options.B: He was following the instructions provided by his legal counsel.
options.C: He felt that the questions were repetitive and had already been answered.
options.D: He argued that the documents released by Senator Paul were private and should remain confidential.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，Dr. Fauci 明確表示他是「under the advice of my attorneys」（在律師建議下）引用第五修正案。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到他確實被傳喚（subpoenaed）且並未質疑其合法性；選項 C 雖然在第五段提到他曾說過類似的話，但這並非他拒絕回答本次聽證會提問的「直接原因」；選項 D 則完全未提及。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what is the most likely reason Senator Paul released Dr. Fauci's private diary entries?

options.A: To demonstrate how the scientific community's understanding of the virus changed over time.
options.B: To provide transparency regarding the government's handling of the pandemic.
options.C: To find evidence that supports his long-standing claims about Dr. Fauci's dishonesty.
options.D: To prove that the virus originated at the Wuhan Institute of Virology.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段與第五段，Senator Paul 聲稱日記顯示 Dr. Fauci 私下與公開說法不一，且其律師團隊指出參議員長期致力於攻擊 Dr. Fauci，試圖將其定罪，顯示其動機在於尋找指控 Dr. Fauci 的證據。選項 A 是科學界的觀點，而非參議員的動機；選項 B 是參議員可能對外宣稱的藉口，但從上下文判斷其目的是攻擊；選項 D 雖然是爭議焦點，但日記本身並未直接「證明」實驗室洩漏論。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, the phrase 'years-long public crusade' is used to describe Senator Paul's actions. What does 'crusade' imply in this context?

options.A: A persistent and passionate campaign to achieve a specific goal.
options.B: A legal battle that is strictly limited to the courtroom.
options.C: A cooperative effort to uncover the truth about a scientific mystery.
options.D: A series of accidental events that led to a misunderstanding.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，crusade 指的是一種強烈、持續且帶有使命感的行動或運動。Dr. Fauci 的律師用此詞來形容參議員長年針對個人的攻擊行為。選項 B 錯誤，因為這不限於法庭；選項 C 完全相反，這並非合作；選項 D 錯誤，因為這是有意為之的行動，而非意外。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main point of the article?

options.A: The scientific community has finally reached a consensus on the origins of COVID-19.
options.B: Dr. Fauci has been found guilty of hiding information about the pandemic.
options.C: Senator Paul and Dr. Fauci are engaged in a long-standing political conflict over the origins of the pandemic.
options.D: The Fifth Amendment is the most effective tool for government officials to avoid public accountability.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於報導 Dr. Fauci 與 Senator Paul 之間長期的爭執，特別是關於疫情起源的辯論以及近期因日記公開而升溫的對立。選項 A 與事實不符，科學界仍有爭論；選項 B 不正確，文中僅提到指控，並未定罪；選項 D 過度推論，文章僅描述了該事件中第五修正案的使用，而非探討其作為問責工具的普遍有效性。
